label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 222 ]

blocks.text: The claim that we have recently entered the information age is misleading. Flooded by cellphones, the Internet, and television, we incorrectly imagine that our ancestors inhabited an innocent world where the news did not travel far beyond the village. It may not be valid to assume that the media make our time distinct from the past, because we know relatively little about how information was shared in the past.

In fact, the Olympics celebrate the memory of the Greek soldier who brought the news of the Athenian victory over the Persians. Most of us could come up with many other examples―message drums, smoke signals, church bells, ship flags. But their primitiveness would only confirm our sense that we live in a fundamentally different world, one of constant, instant access to information.
All ages have had a means of sharing information.

What makes our time distinct is not the density of the data we take in. It is the technology that does the transmitting. Thanks to satellites, we can find out instantly about events that occur on the other side of the world. It usually took five weeks for Benjamin Franklin in Paris to receive a letter sent from Philadelphia. But the news was still new and surprising to people there.

readingSentences.english: In fact, the Olympics celebrate the memory of the Greek soldier who brought the news of the Athenian victory over the Persians.
readingSentences.korean: 사실 올림픽은 페르시아인에 대한 아테네의 승리 소식을 전한 그리스 병사의 기억을 기리기 위해 거행되는 것이다.

readingSentences.english: Most of us could come up with many other examples―message drums, smoke signals, church bells, ship flags.
readingSentences.korean: 우리 대부분은 통신용 북, 연기 신호, 교회 종, 선박의 깃발 등 다른 많은 사례들을 떠올릴 수 있을 것이다.

readingSentences.english: But their primitiveness would only confirm our sense that we live in a fundamentally different world, one of constant, instant access to information.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 그러한 원시적인 방법들은 우리가 정보에 끊임없이 즉각적으로 접근할 수 있는 근본적으로 다른 세상에 살고 있다는 우리의 느낌만을 확인할 뿐이다.

readingSentences.english: All ages have had a means of sharing information.
readingSentences.korean: 모든 시대는 정보를 공유하는 나름의 수단을 가지고 있었다.

readingSentences.english: What makes our time distinct is not the density of the data we take in.
readingSentences.korean: 우리 시대를 과거와 구별 지어 주는 것은 우리가 받아들이는 정보의 밀도가 아니다.

readingSentences.english: It is the technology that does the transmitting.
readingSentences.korean: 그것은 바로 정보를 전송해 주는 과학 기술이다.

readingSentences.english: Thanks to satellites, we can find out instantly about events that occur on the other side of the world.
readingSentences.korean: 인공위성 덕분에 우리는 지구 반대편에서 일어나는 사건들에 대해서도 즉각적으로 알 수 있다.

readingSentences.english: It usually took five weeks for Benjamin Franklin in Paris to receive a letter sent from Philadelphia.
readingSentences.korean: 파리에 머물던 벤자민 프랭클린이 필라델피아에서 보낸 편지를 받는 데는 보통 5주일이 걸렸다.

readingSentences.english: But the news was still new and surprising to people there.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 그곳 사람들에게 그 소식은 여전히 새롭고 놀라운 것이었다.
